title: [DECISION] WOLFSSL_CFLAGS factored in Kbuild
description: Kbuild now defines WOLFSSL_CFLAGS once and applies it to all wolfssl provider CFLAGS_*.o targets. Previous commit had the full flag list repeated per-file. The new pattern is correct: adding a new provider file requires one line (CFLAGS_new_file.o := ) and adding it to crypto2dev_wolfssl-objs. No DRY violation.
